correctness.rationale: Independent out-neighborhoods are disjoint nonempty clone-fiber identifiers, so the three-variable Twin(x,y)=∀z(E(x,z)↔E(y,z)) exactly recovers a fiber. With locally scoped shadowing, at most k reusable variables test ≥j members of a class for 1≤j≤k; decorated 3-variable closed walks recover the directed cycle length and the clipped-size necklace. An indefinite k-pebble partial-injection strategy proves converse. At two variables a vertex adjacent in some direction to every other vertex exists exactly for singleton fibers on triangle quotient; this yields four s=0,1,2,3 theories, with a generic two-pebble back-and-forth for s=0. Burnside yields N_L,k=(1/L)∑_{d|L}φ(d)k^(L/d) and weighted minimal-size polynomial. I reproduced necklace counts by direct cyclic orbit enumeration for L=3,4,5 and k=3,4; source fixed-point pebble checker and formula-evaluator were inspected, not treated as infinite proof. Relative family L≥3, all a_i≥1, arc/equality signature and counting-free FO^k is essential.
